nested_threshold_replay: Recompute only deterministic nested B0 selection, verify selected epoch and nested patient Macro-F1 against each of the 25 COMPLETE records; reuse saved OOF predictions and refit checkpoints without retraining them. Apply nested selected NEZ probability threshold to corresponding refit B0 OOF logits to define K0.

oracle.ordering: descending frozen B0 EZ logit, stable original channel order for exact-score ties
oracle.optimal_set: retain all K with score within 1e-12 of maximum, including disconnected sets
oracle.parity: compare with prior threshold oracle; any discrepancy on non-tied patients >1e-9 is a failure; tied patients are separately counted and discrepancy reported
oracle.validation_ceiling_sanity: mean optimal-K validation Macro-F1 must be in [0.69,0.72] before fitting any head

formal_b0.fit_oof: corresponding nested model's selected NEZ probability threshold applied to crossfit refit logits
formal_b0.validation_and_test: historical fold B0 validation-selected NEZ probability threshold
formal_b0.q0: formal B0 predicted EZ channel count divided by patient channel count

target.definition: all optimal K values divided by C, each shifted by q0; interval supervision is union of contiguous optimal-K runs
target.constant_c1: per-patient nearest-to-zero point in the optimal delta union, median across outer-fit OOF patients
target.ties: do not collapse disconnected optimal-K regions

raw_context.features: per-patient median and IQR of each original 88 pre-patient-z feature columns (176 values)
raw_context.missing: SimpleImputer(strategy=median, keep_empty_features if available); fit outer-fit only; all-missing axes filled with zero
raw_context.transform: StandardScaler then PCA(n_components=8, svd_solver=full) fitted on outer-fit only; validation uses transform only

score_context.normalization: within-patient EZ logit z-score using population std, minimum std 1e-8; near operating point measured in this z space

learner.architecture: one linear layer, no hidden layers, zero initialization
learner.input: C2 standardized score context; C3 standardized concatenation of score context and 8D absolute PCA
learner.loss: mean SmoothL1 distance to nearest optimal-delta interval + 0.02*mean(predicted_delta^2)
learner.optimizer: full-batch AdamW lr=0.01 weight_decay=0.01, fixed 500 steps, seed 42
learner.training_scope: outer-fit OOF patients only; no validation label used in fitting

prediction.classification: exact stable top-K by frozen B0 EZ logit; C0 uses exact historical formal B0 classification
prediction.probability: sigmoid(EZ_logit minus midpoint rank-cut threshold); edge K uses threshold one logit unit outside extrema; exact-score ties at requested boundary trigger deterministic top-K classification and are audited

outer_if_pass: one evaluation only; paired patient bootstrap with 10000 resamples seed=42; no tuning
public_privacy: aggregate-only; no patient IDs, channel IDs, patient raw descriptors, prediction arrays, checkpoints or private cache paths
